sources.title: Pennsylvania DEP: public meeting and hearing for the Carbon Node East data center, Nesquehoning
sources.summary: DEP announced a public meeting and hearing on 20 August 2026 for the proposed Carbon Node East data center, with presentations by DEP and Carbon Node East Development, LLC. The hearing takes comments on Chapter 105 Water Obstruction and Encroachment Permit Application E1302226-001 and Individual NPDES Permit Application PAD130057 for stormwater discharge to Broad Run, Dennison Run, Nesquehoning Creek and Exceptional Value wetlands.
sources.date_semantics: Newsroom release dated 19 August 2026 (URL path 2026-08-19). It reports pending permit applications and a scheduled hearing; it does not establish an issued permit or physical works.
